photos.description: The entrance to the 2nd canyon. A new river being born. At this point the muffled sounds of boulders and rocks can be heard moving in the creek.  3 hr hike in 45 min run. A real sling shot ..bobsled run. 2nd decent. First decent made by Chris Roach who gave us the beta. A very unique boating experience in a spectacular place.
